$schema.description: JSON Schema reference for editor support

description.description: Human-readable description displayed alongside the file name in config selectors

inputs.description: Workflow-only required string input names supplied by workflow_call.with. No defaults or optional inputs. A root workflow cannot declare nonempty inputs; forbidden in default.yaml.

command.description: The base command to run (e.g. ["claude", "-p"]). Mutually exclusive with `sdk`.

sdk.description: SDK backend to drive prompt execution instead of `command`. Mutually exclusive with `command`; omitting both selects `jcode` only if neither `command` nor `sdk` is set by applicable `default.yaml` layers. `sdk: jcode` uses the official jcode Rust SDK and requires jcode CLI v0.88.0 or newer; Cruise validates the API handshake and required capabilities at runtime. `sdk: claude` uses claude-agent-sdk. `sdk: opencode` uses a built-in Rust client and a locally managed OpenCode V2 CLI, with no external server or V1 fallback. jcode/Claude model references support `provider/model[:effort]` or a bare model; OpenCode uses catalog-validated `provider/model[:effort]` or native `provider/model#variant`, which cannot be combined. Recognized trailing effort suffixes are reserved; embedded slashes and unknown colon suffixes in model IDs are preserved. Omitted models use OpenCode's configured default.

mcp_servers.description: Workflow-level MCP servers available to every SDK prompt run. Rejected with the command backend. Every effective applicable candidate, including SDK-qualified objects and authoritative retry-chain entries, must support the transport: stdio supports all SDKs, Streamable HTTP requires Claude or OpenCode, and legacy SSE requires Claude. Changing the workflow SDK does not override SDK-qualified objects.

model.description: Default model to use for all steps. Each actual jcode prompt must resolve to a model from its step-level or workflow/default settings; a missing model is an execution error. OpenCode uses catalog-validated provider/model[:effort] or native provider/model#variant, which cannot be combined. Recognized trailing effort suffixes are reserved; embedded slashes and unknown colon suffixes in model IDs are preserved. OpenCode uses its configured default when omitted. Claude and command backends retain their existing no-model behavior. In SDK mode, an array uses its first entry as the primary model and the remaining entries as fallbacks; the command backend uses only the first entry.

plan_model.description: Model to use for plan generation steps; falls back to `model`. A jcode planning prompt must resolve to a model. In SDK mode, an array uses its first entry as the primary model and the remaining entries as fallbacks; the command backend uses only the first entry.

subagent_model.description: Default subagent model for workflow prompt steps and planning (plan/fix/ask). Step values override it. Strings inherit the workflow SDK (default jcode); objects apply only to matching SDK candidates. Only jcode and Claude are supported, not command backends. One nonblank model only, with no arrays, fallback chain, or recognized :effort suffix. Excludes title generation, PR metadata, and workflow generate.

interactive_planning.description: Whether SDK-mode planning uses session tools to ask questions and submit or revise the plan instead of writing `plan.md` directly. Default: true. Applies to SDK backends, including the default `jcode`; it has no effect with a `command` backend, which always uses file-based planning.

pr_language.description: Language for PR descriptions (deprecated, use `languages.pr` instead)

plan_language.description: Language for planning prompts (deprecated, use `languages.plan` instead)

languages.description: Nested language configuration for PR descriptions and planning prompts

env.description: Environment variables to set for all steps

groups.description: Named groups of steps with optional conditions and retry logic

after-pr.description: Steps to run after a PR is created. The github-review step type is allowed only here.

create_pr.description: When true, successful worktree runs commit changes, push the branch, create a pull request, and run after-pr steps. When false, PR processing is skipped and the worktree and artifacts are retained.

cleanup_after_pr.description: When true, the local git worktree and branch are deleted after the PR is created. Has no effect in current-branch mode or for --repo sessions. Default: false.

max_retries.description: Global budgeted graph-transition ceiling; CLI --max-retries overrides. Default: 3.

force_exec.description: Execute direct plan entry points in the current directory instead of planning. Default: false; --no-force-exec opts out for one invocation.

disallowed_tools.description: Default prompt tool restrictions, unioned with step restrictions. An explicit empty list overrides default.yaml.

permission.description: Default agent permission mode for prompt steps. Default: full. read-only and edit are unsupported with command: backends; read-only cannot be combined with allow_commit. Not a sandbox: read-only is enforced by tool restrictions plus a workspace snapshot diff.

computer_use.description: Allow prompt turns to use jcode's macOS desktop-control tool. Default: false; no effect on Linux. Every effective applicable candidate, including SDK-qualified objects and authoritative retry-chain entries, must use jcode, with no command backend. Claude and OpenCode candidates are incompatible; changing only the workflow SDK does not override SDK-qualified objects.

flags.description: Declared workflow flags. Steps reference them with `flag:`; all flags are off when absent. Enable selected flags with `--flag NAME`, a comma-separated name list, or explicit `NAME=on|off|true|false` assignments.

retry.description: Retryable-failure policy for the SDK backends. Optional: without it, only provider rate limits are retried on the same model, unless a workflow-level model array with fallback entries supplies an implicit policy.

model.description: Model to use for this step (overrides workflow-level model)

subagent_model.description: Override the workflow subagent model for this prompt step. Strings inherit the workflow SDK, not a fallback candidate's SDK. Only matching jcode or Claude attempts receive it; recognized :effort suffixes are rejected.

prompt.description: Prompt text to send to the LLM

allow_commit.description: Allow this prompt step to create commits or otherwise advance Git HEAD. Defaults to false and is omitted when false during serialization. Only applies to prompt steps; group-call and workflow-call steps cannot set it to true.

disallowed_tools.description: Additional prompt tool restrictions. Cannot loosen workflow restrictions.

permission.description: Override the workflow-level permission mode for this prompt step. Not allowed on group, workflow_call, or parallel wrapper steps.

computer_use.description: Override the workflow-level computer_use setting for this prompt step.

command.description: Shell command to execute (string or array of strings)

next.description: Next step to execute after this one

parallel.description: Named prompt/command children run concurrently in the same workspace. Join all children before advancing; interrupted blocks restart as a whole. Two children may not share the same output_file, and a child prompt may not read an artifact produced by a sibling via {file:...}.

skip.description: Whether to skip this step (boolean or variable reference)

flag.description: One workflow-level flag name or a non-empty list; the step runs when any listed flag is on.

when.description: Pre-execution condition: skip the step unless the workspace satisfies the rule

if.description: Condition that must be true for this step to run

env.description: Environment variables to set for this step

workflow_call.description: Reference to another cruise workflow YAML file or supported GitHub URL to inline

with.description: Arguments for workflow_call only. Keys must exactly match the callee inputs; values are strings, including empty strings, with no implicit coercion. Omission or null means no arguments.

prompt_file.description: Path to a file whose contents are used as the prompt. Absolute, ~-prefixed, config-file-relative, or supported GitHub blob/raw URL (a bare file name = same directory). YAML `~` or null denotes the local home directory. Mutually exclusive with prompt.

output_file.description: Relative session artifact file receiving the final output of a prompt step, or the iteration report (JSON) of a github-review step. Mutually exclusive with command, option, parallel, group, and workflow_call.

github-review.description: Opt-in GitHub review bot loop. Only valid directly in after-pr; requires exactly one of prompt or prompt_file and a timeout bounding the whole loop. Cannot be combined with command, option, parallel, group, or workflow_call.

bots.description: Bot logins (case-insensitive, no duplicates). Any one reviewing the current PR head commit ends the wait.

max-iterations.description: Maximum number of review/fix iterations before the step fails.

squash-merge.description: Native synchronous squash merge action. Only valid directly as the final after-pr step and requires exactly the merge flag.

timeout.description: Step timeout. Plain digits = seconds, suffix 'm' = minutes, 'h' = hours. Example: 30, 5m, 1h. A leading '+' and leading zeros are also accepted; zero, negative, and other suffixes are rejected.

exists.description: Skip the step if no file matches this glob (relative to the workflow working dir). Supports variable references.

file-changed.description: Step name to jump to if files were changed during this step's execution

no-file-changes.description: Action to take when no workspace file changes are detected after this step: 'retry' re-executes the step, 'failed' aborts the workflow

oneOf.description: Step name to jump to on failure

fail.description: Action to take when the step fails (including timeout, non-zero exit, prompt error).

text-input.description: Prompt label for free-form text input (mutually exclusive with selector)

next.description: Next step to execute when this option is selected. Omitted, the step's own next applies; without that, the following step in declaration order runs.

if.description: Condition that must be true for the group to run

max_retries.description: Maximum number of retries for steps in this group

steps.description: Named steps belonging to this group

base_delay_ms.description: First backoff step in milliseconds; doubles per attempt up to an 8s ceiling, then jittered down by up to 25%. Default: 500.

max_delay_ms.description: Longest delay cruise will wait before a retry. The computed backoff is already capped at 8s, so this only binds a server Retry-After hint: a hinted delay above it moves the run to its next fallback model, or fails the step when there is none. Default: 300000.

model_fallback.description: Whether a retryable failure may switch models via fallback_chains. Default: true. Workflow-level model arrays with fallback entries always enable model fallback.

fallback_chains.description: Fallback chains keyed by `provider/model`, `provider/*`, `model`, or `default`, each listing the model references to try next. A `provider/*` entry keeps the failing model id and swaps only the provider.

type.description: MCP transport. Defaults to stdio when omitted.

command.description: Command for a stdio MCP server.

url.description: HTTP or SSE MCP server URL.
